item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (62)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 62

  • The open photo is the file’s full resolution, so you can judge it.
  • Move a photo to the Trash after you confirm. On a Mac, Command+Delete does that.
  • Turn a JPEG left or right without recompressing it.
